visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of several slices of thick-cut toast and a round bun on a black wire cooling rack resting on a wooden table. Three white ceramic mugs with a black logo are positioned in the background under bright, warm indoor lighting. (2) The camera pans across a menu board displaying various bread types like "Maple Walnut" and "French Chocolate" with accompanying prices and photos. (3) A digital screen capture shows a social media post from SAKImoto Bakery announcing a 5th-anniversary 90-minute all-you-can-eat event. (4) A male main character with short black hair and glasses, wearing a light grey long-sleeved shirt, sits at the table and takes a bite of the bread with a neutral expression. (5) Shots of the retail area show wicker baskets filled with individually wrapped bread products on shelves. (6) A hand is seen handing a paper receipt to another person at a counter, followed by a close-up of a finger pointing at specific rules on a printed menu. (7) In an open kitchen area, two staff members wearing white t-shirts, tan aprons, and yellow headbands are seen preparing food near professional coffee equipment and ovens. (8) Close-up shots of various toast pieces being pulled apart by hands, showing soft textures and purple taro or dark chocolate fillings inside. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 大家知道最近. [Logo]: 嵜本. (2) [Subtitle]: 日本的高級生吐司專賣店. (3) [Subtitle]: 舉辦了內用吃到飽的活動嗎. (4) [Logo]: SAKImoto Bakery 嵜本 高級生吐司專門店. [Variety]: 嵜本五歲啦! #生吐司 90分鐘吃到飽. (5) [Subtitle]: 透過電話預約都能吃90分鐘的內用麵包吃到飽. (6) [Logo]: SAKImoto bakery. (7) [Subtitle]: 裡面能吃到18款的麵包跟7款飲品 一個人的費用是$399元. (8) [Subtitle]: 不過這個吃到飽有非常多的限制 一個人一次只能點一杯飲料 一片生吐司 跟兩個小麵包. (9) [Subtitle]: 如果餐點有浪費的話 一個人會再多收300元. (10) [Subtitle]: 加上店內只有兩個工作人員 從排隊結帳 到排隊點餐 到最後拿到手上的第一份麵包 時間都過去了好久. (11) [Subtitle]: 因為點完餐之後 店員會再用烤箱幫麵包重新加熱 增加了更多的等待時間. (12) [Subtitle]: 最後在我瘋狂的吃 瘋狂的點 也只能點到三輪 總共是吃了17款的麵包跟4杯飲料. (13) [Subtitle]: 當中我最喜歡的是巧克力跟芋頭口味的生吐司. (14) [Subtitle]: 不知道大家看完之後會想去試看看嗎. (15) [Slogan]: 台北市中山區樂群三路200號. (16) [Subtitle]: 店家的地址我會把它放在這. (17) [Subtitle]: 想看完整的開箱影片. (18) [Slogan]: YouTube搜尋 吃貨豪豪.
